scope: Offline development screen only; no live capture, commands, margin change or endpoint authorization. Do not retune on failed check draws.
reader: Keep the original two-dimensional outer-rim witness and station construction. Fit the inverse depth at the witnessed half-pixel from a connected same-code/pink support ellipse (5 px across, 2 px orthogonal), with the original per-edge continuity tolerance, at least eight samples and center leverage at most 0.25. Fit an affine plane, correcting the second-order inverse-depth noise bias. Fit a row-index slope to three to five consecutive ahead bilateral midpoints, preserving the original local step, chord, skew and minimum-bank limit checks.
sampling: Replay the exact 15 sealed work frames and 360 draws from the pinned calibration protocol; use goal 10, the prior optical prefix, and the same ray marker fit on the same perturbed depth array. Replay the pinned outer-bank gate with v5 on both registered goals and both unchanged narrow controls.
gate: All 15 clean v4/v5 chart and marker pairs must be valid. Clean bias is the maximum absolute change in (limit - optical_tip) dot direction relative to v4 on the same frame. Preserve every outer-bank gate, and require the v5 closed/open front displacement to be strictly less than 0.05 mm for both goals. For all 72 noisy draws at prefix >= 6, require at least 69 same-frame valid chart/marker pairs (at least 95%); each valid pair must strictly satisfy the axis and optimistic room-change thresholds relative to its own clean v5 frame. Keep all refusals in the denominator and report both seed splits. These are sensitivity checks, not absolute errors versus a physical reference.
